entries.04396488bd66bfff: It has formulated a medium-term management plan, “Expansion and Growth,” covering the 3-year period starting from the fiscal year ending December 2026, and will further advance the sophistication of people and organization, which is the source of its strengths. Aiming to realize “comprehensive career track for all employees,” it places emphasis on the growth of each employee; to establish its position as a “co-creation partner in commerce” that continues to be chosen by customers, it works on deepening existing businesses, taking on value-creating businesses, and strengthening the value chain.

entries.13f13e85ad91b809: It operates a single segment, the Display Business, and revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥71,511 million. By type of work produced, interior and exterior construction accounted for ¥65,791 million, the majority. By market category, revenue was: various specialty stores ¥20,650 million, services, etc. ¥19,018 million, mixed-use commercial facilities and general supermarkets ¥14,485 million, restaurants ¥10,301 million, and food supermarkets and convenience stores ¥7,056 million; by region, revenue from external customers in Japan exceeded 90%, and there is no major customer accounting for 10% or more of revenue. Consolidated employees number 990, and it has 5 consolidated subsidiaries, including those in Hong Kong, Shanghai, Vietnam and Okinawa.
